SUBJECT: ED221 INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q.1(a) What is psychology? [2]
Q.1(b) Who is known as the father of psychology? What is the contribution of Sigmund Freud? [3]


Q.2(a) What is the behaviorist perspective of psychology? [2]
Q.2(b) Describe Abraham Maslow’s hierarchy of needs. [3]


Q.3(a) Why is human vision called as sensitive as is physically possible? [2]
Q.3(b) What is hit rate and false alarm rate in signal detection theory? [3]


Q.4 Explain  the difference  between  absolute  threshold  and  just  noticeable  difference  of  sensory
modalities.
[5]


Q.5 Explain the five functions of perception. [5]
